newsitem.title: USA: Undercover detectives groped in Florida gay club raid.
newsitem.headline: Undercover detectives groped in Florida gay club raid.

text.p: Undercover detectives arrested 21 men for lewd and lascivious behavior in a night-time raid on a Miami Beach gay club, and some of the investigators were groped during the raid, police said Thursday.

Staff and customers at the Boardwalk club on Collins Avenue on Wednesday night were exposing themselves and in some cases masturbating themselves or each other in an open area, a police statement said.
"In a few cases the detectives themselves were battered when some of the individuals approached and began groping the investigators' bodies," it said.
Charges filed against the 21 men included lewd and lascivious behavior, exposure of sexual organs, battery and drugs possession.

Miami Beach's large gay community came under intense scrutiny after the July 15 murder of Italian fashion designer Gianni Versace. His suspected killer, homosexual prostitute Andrew Cunanan, shot himself on a houseboat moored off Collins Avenue eight days later.
Gay activists said media coverage played up negative stereotypes of the homosexual lifestyle. They have also often accused police of a campaign of harassment against them.
